'''Abaarian''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Abaarian system/Legends|Abaarian system]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. The world joined the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] in the wake of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], shipping bottled [[Water/Legends|water]] to needy planets. Several of these water shipments were hijacked during the [[Dark Nest Crisis]]. The [[Jedi High Council (New Jedi Order)|Jedi High Council]] dispatched [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Tesar Sebatyne]] and [[Lowbacca]] to investigate.<ref name="Unseen Queen" />
